image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a bright blue plastic barrel situated outdoors on a gravel and dirt surface next to green grass. The barrel occupies the right side of the frame. It has horizontal ridges typical of industrial drums. The top rim is visible, but the lid area is cut off by the frame edge. No downspout, spigot, or overflow outlet is clearly visible in this cropped view.
